title: hive-pool complete-question: request body
description: Records the owner's disposition completed for the applied answer of a question: the question is closed and no work is released by it. Its word hold is released in the same transaction only where nothing is left for it to gate: the held item, as it stands in the transaction, is a decision item (deliverable decision), or the held item and every item beneath it are archived. Refused with pool.question_unanswered for a question with no applied answer, pool.question_closed for one already released, completed or moot, and pool.question_holds_work while the held item is work that is not archived, which the owner releases, or archives first. The envelope's expected_revisions names the question's record revision. One of the operations the Mind's word persists through: refused with authority_insufficient unless the request is a handoff from the hive-word command of the package word. See spec/word.md.

note.description: The owner's disposition note, its own words on the card, never the Hive Mind's.

evidence.description: What the owner did on the answer, where it names a record.

requested_by.description: The caller of the hive-word request, recorded as the disposition's by.
